## Summary

Describe the change, its scope, and the evidence used to validate it.

## Safety and privacy checklist

- [ ] I ran `npm test`, `npm run docs:check`, and `npm run validate:skill`.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, cookies, session data, private URLs, or personal extraction output.
- [ ] New commands remain read-only and use argument arrays without a shell.
- [ ] External transmission, authentication, permission, and retention changes are documented.
- [ ] New third-party components are pinned where practical and recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] Documentation and tests cover security-relevant behavior changes.
